spec.bug: A change to one live block starts a full reprint: the whole-transcript cost per update.
spec.find:
BlockChanged(id) ==
    /\ alive /\ id \in live
    /\ out' = <<[kind |-> "repaint_block", id |-> id]>> /\ act' = [name |-> "BlockChanged", id |-> id]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<core, alive, cycleStarts>>

BlockChanged(id) ==
    /\ alive /\ id \in live
    /\ out' = <<[kind |-> "repaint_block", id |-> id]>> /\ act' = [name |-> "BlockChanged", id |-> id]
    /\ reprinting' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cycle, cycleFirst, prevFirst, nextSeq, savedThrough, live, turnOpen, prevWaits, paintedThrough, coOpen, coLo, coHi, coAtStart, pending, pendingDir, nextToken, alive, cycleStarts>>
